description: Explain what a verification status or reason means in plain English, with a send recommendation. Covers valid, invalid, catch-all/accept-all, unknown, greylisted, disposable, role, free, spam-trap, abuse, do-not-mail, no-mx, disabled, and network. Use when a user asks what a result means.

term.description: The status/reason to explain, e.g. 'catch-all', 'GREYLISTED', 'unknown', 'role'. Case-insensitive.

name: explain_result
